adaptations: One detail controller owns rendering, child dismissal, save recovery and chart disposal for both entry paths.

Fetch the canonical detail on every open before enabling edits, as source openDetail does. This prevents a stale revision when reopening a card before its parent refresh completes. A deterministic delayed-parent-refresh browser check reproduces and covers this case.
limits: Browser evidence uses production HTTP, transactions, CSP and canonical projections with fixture data. Hosted acceptance remains the parent task.
